steps.title: Caller invokes
steps.desc: Any UI / ACP bridge / hook calls ctx.agents.create() or resume() without importing the loop.

steps.title: Factory re-traced
steps.desc: Registry forwards through the caller's own context to the one registered AgentFactory.

steps.title: One factory
steps.desc: AgentLoop registers itself via ctx.agents.setFactory(this); a second registration throws.

steps.title: Ordered lifecycle
steps.desc: setup() runs first, then enter() id-check + announce() emits agent/created exactly once.

steps.title: Plain register
steps.desc: A custom driver hands an already-built Agent to ctx.agents.register() directly, bypassing the factory.
